## Core Content Categories
1. Heritage & History: Information about seven-generation perfumery tradition
2. Craftsmanship: Deg Bhapka distillation technique (500+ years old)
3. Products: Natural attars including Gulab, Mitti, Shamama, Hina varieties
4. Ingredients: Sourced from across India (Kannauj roses, Mysore sandalwood, Rajasthan vetiver, Kashmir saffron, Assam oud, Madurai jasmine)
5. Philosophy: Emphasis on authenticity, heritage, and artisanal quality
6. Inquiry/Contact: Contact form for customer inquiries
